page.overview:
Who is Bryn?

Bryn was a Human male captain who served in the Special Forces of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War, around 3643 BBY, he was stationed on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas, where he performed reconnaissance on Lord Grathan, a rogue Sith Lord who had declared himself the thirteenth member of the Dark Council.

Bryn held the rank of captain within Imperial Special Forces during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. At one point during his career, he was stationed on a bridge on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas between the Wall and the estate of rogue Sith Lord Grathan, At this position, he was tasked with keeping watch on Grathan while maintaining his distance. As part of his orders, he was to retrieve the plans for a prototype turret that his superiors wanted to mass-produce, but his orders also specified that he could not enter Grathan's territory. He requested the aid of a passing individual affiliated with the Sith Empire to retrieve the plans.

The Imperial individual successfully infiltrated Grathan's compound, retrieving a security badge from a member of Lord Grathan's forces in order to pass by its automated defenses. The individual broke into Grathan's weapons lab and downloaded the plans from the databanks of the droid PO-12, much to its chagrin; it wanted to destroy the schematics and ensure no more turrets could be built. Upon the individual's return, Bryn displayed an eagerness to test the efficacy of the turrets on Republic personnel.

After the individual's mission, Bryn remained posted on the bridge, continuing to keep watch over Grathan's estate.
